今天的午饭很丰盛，师娘贴的饼子，还切了一盘猪头肉，还炒了一盘鸡蛋。这样的伙食已经比绝大多数人家好太多了。师娘不停的给王野夹菜，看得平三卓都眼气了：“你个老太婆，是一点不打算给我留呀！全给这个臭小子夹碗里了。”

师娘也不示弱：“你个老头子吃什么，小野正在长身体呢！就得多吃。”

平三卓也不敢继续顶嘴了，这要是把师娘惹急眼了，是真没饭吃。

一顿饭吃的可以算其乐融融，除了平三卓。吃完饭，师徒两人又进了书房，王野一坐下就问：“师父，夺命三针研究的怎么样了？”

平三卓喝了口水说：“夺阴，夺阳没问题了。只是这夺魂不行啊，我越研究越觉得这，玩意儿应该是传说中的东西。”

王野问：“怎么就传说中的东西了？修仙儿呀？”

平三卓没好气的说：“和踏马修仙儿差不多！让以气行针。”

“我怎么研究怎么觉得不靠谱，跟踏马炼丹一样，我觉得就是忽悠人的。”

王野说：“师父，你说是不是得到传说中的化劲期呀？”

平三卓说：“还化劲，你回家问问赵老头，有记载的化劲期，上一个是武当三丰真人。我是不知道还有谁！”

王野继续说：“不对呀！师父，我赵爷爷说他没受伤之前，摸到化劲的门槛儿了。”

平三卓说：“历史上摸到门槛的多了，进门的就那么几个。”

王野说：“那师父，我赵爷爷的伤，能治吗？”

平三卓说：“能治，有你的药丸，加上夺阳针，虽然不能让他恢复巅峰，但是活到寿终正寝不难。”

王野立刻就放心了说：“能健康长寿就行了，这么大岁数了，还能让他老人家去打打杀杀呀！”

平三卓继续说：“就是能治，现在也不行？”

王野疑惑的问：“为什么呀？”

平三卓说：“需要的药有点多。”

王野说：“有点多是多少呀？”

平三卓无力的说：“你那个药丸，你赵爷爷得吃一年，中间不能间断。你自己算算吧，得需要多少人参？”

王野吃惊的说：“这么多呀！”王野有这些人参，可是见不得光呀！

平三卓继续说：“其实你赵爷爷可以向上面申请，可是那个犟驴肯定不会去麻烦上面。那老头子宁可住在一个小破屋里，都不去申请独门独院，你就知道这老头子多犟了。”

王野说：“等等吧！我找机会去一趟东北，相信那里应该可以找到。”

平三卓说：“也只能这样了。

又聊了一会儿，平三卓又给王野拿了三本医书，王野就告辞了。王野骑车又去了永宁先生家。永宁先生现在一般都是上午有课，下午基本在家看书。

王野一进门就看见永宁先生在院子里喝着茶，拿着一本书聚精会神的看着。王野上前微微鞠躬轻声道：“先生好。”

永宁放下书看见是王野，笑呵呵的说：“是抱朴呀！今天不用上班吗？”

Today's lunch was very sumptuous. The mistress posted pancakes, cut a plate of pork head, and fried a plate of eggs.This kind of food is much better than most other people's homes.The mistress kept picking up vegetables for Wang Ye, which made Ping Sanzhuo angry: "You old woman, you have no intention of leaving any for me! You just put it all in the bowl for this brat."

The teacher's wife didn't show any weakness: "You old man, what do you want to eat? Xiaoye is growing! You just need to eat more."

Ping Sanzhuo didn't dare to talk back anymore. If this made Master Niang anxious, he would really have nothing to eat.

The meal was a pleasant one, except for Ping Sanzhuo.After eating, the master and apprentice entered the study again. As soon as Wang Ye sat down, he asked: "Master, how is the research on the three life-threatening needles going?"

Ping Sanzhuo took a sip of water and said: "Seizing Yin and Seizing Yang is no problem. But this Seizing Soul is not good. The more I study, the more I feel that this thing should be something from legend."

Wang Ye asked: "Why is it just a legendary thing? Xiu Xian'er?"

Ping Sanzhuo said angrily: "It's almost like stepping on Xiu Xian'er! Let the Qi move the needle."

"No matter how I research it, I feel it's unreliable. It's like riding a horse to make elixirs. I think it's just deceiving people."

Wang Ye said: "Master, do you think you have reached the legendary energy transformation stage?"

Ping Sanzhuo said: "Huan Jin, you go home and ask Old Man Zhao. The last recorded stage of Huajin was Wudang Sanfeng Zhenren. I don't know who else is there!"

Wang Ye continued: "That's not right! Master, my grandfather Zhao said that before he was injured, he touched the threshold of energy transformation."

Ping Sanzhuo said: "In history, many people have reached the threshold, but only a few have entered."

Wang Ye said: "Master, can my grandfather Zhao's injury be cured?"

Ping Sanzhuo said: "It can be cured. With your pills and Yang-seizing needles, although it cannot bring him back to his peak, it is not difficult to live until the end of his life."

Wang Ye immediately felt relieved and said: "It's enough to be healthy and live a long life. At such an old age, he can still be allowed to fight and kill!"

Ping Sanzhuo continued: "Even if it can be cured, it can't be cured now?"

Wang Ye asked doubtfully: "Why?"

Ping Sanzhuo said: "It requires a lot of medicine."

Wang Ye said: "How much is a little too much?"

Ping Sanzhuo said feebly: "Your grandfather Zhao has to take your pills for a year without interruption. Do the math for yourself, how much ginseng is needed?"

Wang Ye was surprised and said: "There are so many!" Wang Ye had these ginseng, but he couldn't see the light of it!

Ping Sanzhuo continued: "Actually, your Grandpa Zhao can apply to the higher authorities, but that stubborn donkey will definitely not bother the higher authorities. That old man would rather live in a small shabby house than apply for a private courtyard. You will know how stubborn this old man is."

Wang Ye said: "Wait a minute! I'll look for an opportunity to go to the Northeast. I believe I can find it there."

Ping Sanzhuo said: “That’s all it can do.

After chatting for a while, Ping Sanzhuo brought three more medical books to Wang Ye, and Wang Ye left.Wang Ye rode his bicycle to Mr. Yongning's house again.Mr. Yongning usually has classes in the morning and basically reads at home in the afternoon.

As soon as Wang Ye entered the door, he saw Mr. Yongning drinking tea in the yard, holding a book and reading attentively.Wang Ye stepped forward, bowed slightly and said softly: "Hello, sir."

Yongning put down the book and saw Wang Ye, and said with a smile: "It's Baopu!"Don't you have to go to work today?"
